svg.aria-label: The eight explosion frames of Phoenix, each a 3x2 block of six characters resolved through an address table, with the character codes listed.
svg.title: An explosion, frame by frame
svg.text: Eight frames from phoenix_alien_explosion_frames. Those bytes are not characters - they are addresses.
alien_logic.c turns each byte into 0x1700 | byte and hands it to the 3x2 routine, which reads six characters from there.
drawNx2 with n=3 · 6 characters · 24 x 16 pixels
alien_logic.c calls attract_mode.c: drawNx2(0x1700 | img, de, 0xFFDF, 3)
Frame 0 resolves to six zero bytes: that is the erase step, not a missing frame. Then one spark, then debris, then the full burst.
The last frames alternate between two full bursts, which is the flicker you see on screen.
The characters all come from colour group 6, the red explosion family.
